The '''Peragus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Peragus II]] and the [[Peragus asteroid field]], which during the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]] was the location of the [[Peragus Mining Facility]].

==History==
Peragus sold fuel to [[Telos IV]] during its [[Telosian Restoration Project|planetary recovery]] effort. Peragus II, along with the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field, was destroyed during the [[First Jedi Purge]].
[[File:PeragusSystem-BOTE1.jpg|thumb|left|A location in the Peragus system.]]
[[3678 BBY|Hundreds of years]] after the explosive destruction of the [[Peragus Mining Facility]], the Peragus system became a haven for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and they established a minor fuel depot there. A true-blooded [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] came there to sell out secrets of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] to a smuggler. [[Exal Kressh|She]] was attacked by other smugglers shortly after her business deal, but killed them by [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choking]] them all. Along the way, she was plagued by thoughts of her master, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], who she had somehow betrayed. Apparently, the two had a telepathic link.
